gen-gf-revalia-gf-alexandria: Loud, loose and a bit theatrical, Revalia spreads its wide-set letters out with a relaxed stride. And Alexandria follows in a plain sans with tall, open lettering, so a long page of text moves along without any fuss.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and unfussy, its tall strokes ending in terminals that flare outward like tongs. But Revalia is the one to lean on for bold, expressive display, while the sans below simply gets on with the text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla is approachable and a little wide in its s curves, with a short climb from midline to ascender. Anek Bangla keeps a long passage moving easily, which gives Revalia's bold, loose display letters something friendly to hand off to.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari reads modern and measured, with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone. And Revalia earns its keep when set big and short, where its bold, widely spaced letters can stretch out.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Revalia's lowercase g swings open at the bottom, wide and bold. Anek Gurmukhi follows in a plain sans with generous counters and open-handed rounds, so a long stretch of text stays clean and easy going.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-kannada: Revalia brings bold, expressive display letters that sprawl out with a relaxed stride and a tall band of lowercase. Anek Kannada does the opposite job in sans-serif, with a high x-height and terminals that stop well short of the stem.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-latin: Expressive and brash, Revalia spreads out with a g that stays open below. Anek Latin keeps a long read tidy, its tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals and its shapes held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-odia: Revalia is bold and expressive, with a g open at the bottom and wide gaps between letters. But Anek Odia handles the sustained reading in sans-serif, its rounds left unsealed and its capitals sitting just above lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-tamil: That open-bottomed g, sitting in a tall band of widely spaced letters, is Revalia's signature. Anek Tamil takes over in plain sans with big round bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, a relaxed partner for the display type.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu sets a reading rhythm of wide, tall bowls, with rounds that stay unsealed like an unlatched hook. Revalia adds bold, expressive display letters above that plain sans.
